# Generated C0 Config projection

These files are generated by `tool/gen_c0_projection.dart` from the neutral,
authenticated `c0-fixtures-r1` release under `contracts/c0/`. They are an
auditable JSON projection of the same release that generates
`lib/src/c0_config_contract.g.dart`.

Never edit the JSON file, its `SHA256SUMS`, or the generated Dart contract by
hand. Regenerate them with:

```console
dart run tool/gen_c0_projection.dart
```

Verify committed bytes without changing them with:

```console
dart run tool/gen_c0_projection.dart --check
```
